name: Hitbox
lead: An invisible box a player can click, and a wall when solid, from `world.hitbox` (1.19.4 and later).

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Removes the hitbox, and its wall when solid.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Its entity id, what `players.on_click` reports in `hit.entity_id`.

fields.name: at
fields.description: Its bottom centre; write it to move the hitbox, and its wall when solid.
